entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Isaac, this VeloBand Cadence Sensor you sold me is a piece of junk. It's not working and I want my money back. Now.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with your VeloBand. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
A technical fault? It's completely broken! It won't sync with my app, it won't sync with my bike computer, it's useless! I've been trying for an hour. This thing is defective.
Okay, I understand your frustration. When you say it won't sync, have you tried...

Don't you dare try to make me troubleshoot this garbage. I paid for a product that works out of the box. This is ridiculous. I want a refund and I want it now. If you can't do that, get me a manager who can, before I tell everyone on the internet what a scam VeloFit is running.

I understand completely, sir. There's no need for a manager, I can certainly look into the return options for you. Let me just pull up your order. I see you received the sensor 9 days ago, is that correct?
Yeah, that sounds about right. So what are you going to do about it?
Well, I'm checking our policy now, and you are well within the 90-day return window. Since the item is defective, I can absolutely process a full refund for you right away.
Wait, really? You're just going to give me the refund? No more hassle?

That's correct. I apologize again for the trouble you've had with this broken device. I am processing the return authorization now and I will email you a prepaid shipping label to send the sensor back to us. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be issued to your original form of payment.
Huh. Okay. Well... good. That's what I wanted. Send me the label.
The email has just been sent. You should see it in your inbox shortly. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a better rest of your day.
